# Metacritic — reception overview and review leads

- Original source: [Metacritic — reception overview and review leads](https://www.metacritic.com/game/robin-hood-the-legend-of-sherwood/)
- Author / publication: Metacritic
- Language / date: English; dynamic listing checked 2026-09-09
- Access: Indexed listing inspected
- Checked: 2026-09-09
- Format: original summary and research notes; not a transcript.

The retrieved listing reports a critic aggregate of **80/100 from 15 reviews**. It includes favorable and mixed assessments rather than unanimous praise.

Its listed review leads include Yahoo! (90), GameSpy (87), Game Over Online (79), Pregaming (70), and Computer Games Magazine (60). The magazine citation points to February 2003, page 78. These are aggregator-reported scores; the original articles should be consulted before attributing detailed arguments to those publications.

The GameSpy excerpt emphasizes mission design, character abilities, and resource management. The Computer Games Magazine excerpt objects to frustration undermining the challenge.

**Limitations:** review counts and audience ratings can change. Aggregation does not independently establish gameplay facts, and a short excerpt is not a substitute for the original review.
